import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
scatter = axes[0, 0].scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                             c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='viridis', 
                             s=df['Physical Activity Level']/2, alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality with Stress Level', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[0, 0])
cbar.set_label('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=10)

# 2. Average Sleep Metrics by Occupation
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')[['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep']].mean().sort_values('Quality of Sleep', ascending=False)
x = np.arange(len(occupation_sleep.index))
width = 0.35
bars1 = axes[0, 1].bar(x - width/2, occupation_sleep['Sleep Duration'], width, label='Sleep Duration', color='skyblue')
bars2 = axes[0, 1].bar(x + width/2, occupation_sleep['Quality of Sleep'], width, label='Quality of Sleep', color='lightcoral')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Average Score', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Sleep Metrics by Occupation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xticks(x)
axes[0, 1].set_xticklabels(occupation_sleep.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
axes[0, 1].legend()

# 3. Distribution of Sleep Duration by BMI Category
bmi_order = ['Underweight', 'Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
for bmi in bmi_order:
    subset = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi]['Sleep Duration']
    axes[0, 2].hist(subset, alpha=0.6, label=bmi, bins=15, density=True)
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Density', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by BMI Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 2].legend()

# 4. Physical Activity vs Stress Level by Gender
for gender in df['Gender'].unique():
    subset = df[df['Gender'] == gender]
    axes[1, 0].scatter(subset['Physical Activity Level'], subset['Stress Level'], 
                       alpha=0.6, label=gender, s=50)
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level (minutes/day)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress Level by Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].legend()

# 5. Correlation Heatmap of Numerical Features
numerical_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                  'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
im = axes[1, 1].imshow(corr_matrix, cmap='coolwarm', vmin=-1, vmax=1)
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(np.arange(len(numerical_cols)))
axes[1, 1].set_yticks(np.arange(len(numerical_cols)))
axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(numerical_cols, rotation=45, ha='right')
axes[1, 1].set_yticklabels(numerical_cols)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Correlation Heatmap of Numerical Features', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=axes[1, 1])
cbar.set_label('Correlation Coefficient', fontsize=10)

# Add correlation values to heatmap
for i in range(len(numerical_cols)):
    for j in range(len(numerical_cols)):
        text = axes[1, 1].text(j, i, f'{corr_matrix.iloc[i, j]:.2f}',
                               ha="center", va="center", color="black", fontsize=8)

# 6. Sleep Disorder Distribution by Age Group
df['Age Group'] = pd.cut(df['Age'], bins=[0, 30, 40, 50, 100], labels=['<30', '30-40', '40-50', '50+'])
disorder_by_age = pd.crosstab(df['Age Group'], df['Sleep Disorder'], normalize='index') * 100
disorder_by_age.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=axes[1, 2], colormap='Set2')
axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Percentage (%)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 2].set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 2].legend(title='Sleep Disorder', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
axes[1, 2].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# Adjust layout
plt.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
